basic_details.job_title: SCTIMST Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for one Project Associate I post at the Biomedical Technology Wing of Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Trivandrum, is on 19 November 2026 at 10:30 AM. Reporting time is 09:30 AM at the Biomedical Technology Wing, Satelmond Palace, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram-695 012. The post is on a DST-funded project and pays Rs.31,000 or Rs.25,000 per month plus 20% HRA; the vacancy is for an ST candidate, and UR will be considered if no eligible ST candidate is available.

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Associate I Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Biomedical Technology Wing, Satelmond Palace, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram-695 012
Rs.31,000/- + 20% HRA per month with essential qualification (ii); Rs.25,000/- + 20% HRA for others
Candidates with M.Sc Biotechnology or Biochemistry who meet the qualification below; ST candidates, or UR if no eligible ST candidate is available

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology, Trivandrum is an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. The recruitment is issued by its Biomedical Technology Wing at Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The post is for the DST-funded project "Investigation of aberrant phenotype and functions of rheumatoid arthritis polymorphic PAD4" (P.8279).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites applicants for one post of Project Associate I. The vacancy is existing and is for an ST candidate. In the absence of eligible ST candidates, UR will be considered. M.Sc Biotechnology or Biochemistry. Qualified in any of the National Eligibility Test like GATE or UGC-CSIR-NET, or selected under a National Level Exam conducted by agencies like DST, DBT, ICMR, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, IIT, IISc, IISER, SCTIMST, etc. or equivalent bodies. Hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, real-time PCR (qPCR), western blotting and other molecular biology techniques. Where experience is prescribed, it means experience gained after acquiring the prescribed essential qualification. The age limit is 35 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. The appointment is initially for a period up to 31.03.2027, likely to be extended up to 16.11.2030. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

rows.post: Project Associate I (with essential qualification (ii) above)

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST Project Associate I Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in laboratory-based research activities, including mammalian cell culture, real-time PCR (qPCR), Western blotting and routine molecular biology techniques. Experimental execution, data collection and documentation. Maintenance of laboratory records. Support the research activities as assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled Recruitment Report Form. Bio-data. Original and self-attested copies of certificates to prove age, qualifications and experience. For ST candidates, a caste certificate in the prescribed format applicable for employment in Central Govt. Institutions, issued by a Revenue Officer not below the rank of a Tahsildar. For candidates already in service, a No Objection Certificate from the present employer, to be produced at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Selection is by walk-in interview. Depending on the number of candidates, a written test of a qualifying nature may be conducted for initial screening, and only qualified candidates will be called for interview. Marks obtained in the written test, if conducted, will not be counted for final ranking.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 09.30 AM will not be considered for selection. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Links
content_sections.text: The notice gives telephone numbers 0471-2340801 / 2520450 and the email address [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the SCTIMST Project Associate I walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 19 November 2026 at 10:30 AM. Candidates must report at 09:30 AM, and those reporting after 09:30 AM will not be considered for selection.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the SCTIMST walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The venue is the Biomedical Technology Wing, Satelmond Palace, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram-695 012.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 existing vacancy, for an ST candidate. If no eligible ST candidate is available, UR will be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc in Biotechnology or Biochemistry. They must also have qualified in a National Eligibility Test such as GATE or UGC-CSIR-NET, or been selected under a national level exam conducted by agencies like DST, DBT, ICMR, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, IIT, IISc, IISER, SCTIMST, etc. or equivalent bodies.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of SCTIMST Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.31,000/- per month plus 20% HRA for those with essential qualification (ii), the national-level test qualification. Others get Rs.25,000/- per month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the monthly pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the pay as Rs.31,000/- + 20% HRA per month, or Rs.25,000/- + 20% HRA per month for others.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should candidates bring?
faq.answer: They should bring the duly filled Recruitment Report Form, bio-data, and original and self-attested copies of certificates for age, qualifications and experience. ST candidates also need a caste certificate in the prescribed format, and candidates already in service need a No Objection Certificate.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by walk-in interview. A qualifying written test may be held for initial screening depending on the number of candidates, but its marks are not counted for final ranking.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the appointment, and is TA/DA paid?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially up to 31.03.2027, likely to be extended up to 16.11.2030. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
